description: This is a React component implementing a login screen. It handles user input for email and password, simulates authentication by setting a cookie, redirects upon form submission, and displays UI elements such as role toggles, background SVG art, and social login buttons.

methods.name: clampNextPath
methods.description: Ensures the 'next' URL parameter is a safe internal route, defaulting to '/ingestion' if invalid.

methods.name: setAuthCookie
methods.description: Sets a cookie named 'cn_auth' with user role and email information, including a timestamp.

methods.name: LoginClient
methods.description: Main React component rendering the login UI, handling user input, and managing authentication simulation.
